narrative.overview: A handcrafted adult fairytale stage where layered midnight paper frames warm, accessible story content. Native controls remain familiar while ornamental depth carries the identity.

rules.name: Character Constancy
rules.body: Narrator is blue, Elara is burgundy, and Fox is orange across cast, player, and read-along screens.

rules.name: Attached Paper
rules.body: Every shadow must make an element feel physically attached to the stage.

dos: Do keep functional content native and accessible.
Do use transparent papercraft assets for ornamental depth.
donts: Don't use neon, glassmorphism, or color-only speaker states.
